title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12475__PART_1_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12475__PART_1_) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12475__PART_1_). 0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part I ) was adopted by the 1988, after the draft finalized by the Liquid and Gaseous Dielectrics Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. 0.2 The electrical performance of oil impregnated paper insulation used in transformers, cables or capacitors is strongly affected by the presence of small gaseous bubbles which can give rise to partial discharges and eventual insulation breakdown. Therefore, gassing properties of insulating liquids, that is, the tendency to absorb or evolve gases have been recognized as factors of major iqjportance to characterize the dielectric liquids used as impregnant in oil paper insulation, 0.3 The gassing behaviour of any liquid is primarily a function of its chemistry but change in certain test parameters can modify the result significantly. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
